name: Claude Code v2.1.251 — Critical Security Fixes + PreModelSwitch Hooks + Spend Limit Bar
hook: Shipped August 28. Four critical security patches land in 2.1.251: file tools following symlinks swapped after permission checks, plugin commands pointing outside the plugin directory, the Workflow tool reading files outside approved locations, and Grep/Glob not applying deny rules through symlinked paths. Same release adds PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch hook events (block, confirm, or annotate model switches in CI), a spend-limit progress bar in /usage, and a per-session prompt-cache line in /cost with hit ratio, miss count, and tokens re-cached. Fixed Opus 5 failures on xhigh/max effort with thinking disabled.

name: ayghri/i-have-adhd — 25.5K Stars; ADHD-Friendly Output Skill; Answer First, Always
hook: 25.5K stars — grew from ~5K to 25K in under a month. name: nanocoai/nanoclaw — 30.6K Stars; Lightweight OpenClaw Alternative; Agents in Containers
hook: 30.6K stars for a stripped-down, containerized alternative to OpenClaw. Agents run in Docker with full filesystem isolation — not just application-level permission checks. Connects Claude agents to WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Teams, iMessage, and Gmail. Per-agent workspace (isolated memory, containers, mounts), credentials via Agent Vault, scheduled jobs with script gates, and web search/fetch. Codebase is intentionally small enough to read in one session; you fork it and have Claude Code customize it for your needs. MIT.
install: git clone https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw.git nanoclaw-v2 && cd nanoclaw-v2 && bash nanoclaw.sh
